message:
Merge pull request #27 from zeugmaster/melt-change-outcome

Report melt change recovery explicitly instead of swallowing errors

Merge pull request #29 from zeugmaster/onchain-melt

Accept FAILED melt quote state

Accept FAILED melt quote state

cdk reports FAILED for a payout that did not go out after the quote was
executed, for example an onchain broadcast that never happened. The
strict QuoteState decoder rejected the whole quote, so a wallet polling
a NUT-30 withdrawal could never learn that its inputs were released.

Add the case, treat it like UNPAID in the melt-state paths (no change,
no settlement), and document it for wallets.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
